name: Human Excretory System (Urinary System)
semanticDescription: Medical-grade anatomical model of the human urinary excretory system featuring paired bean-shaped kidneys with medial hilum, coronal section of kidney displaying outer renal cortex, striated medullary pyramids, columns of Bertin, renal papillae, calyces, and renal pelvis cavity; suprarenal adrenal glands capping superior poles; abdominal aorta with renal arteries and common iliac bifurcations; inferior vena cava with left renal vein crossing anterior to aorta; bilateral ureters inserting into the bladder trigone, muscular detrusor urinary bladder, and urethra (CBSE Class 10 Biology Ch 5 Figure 5.13; CBSE Class 11 Biology Ch 19 Figures 19.1, 19.2).
simplifications: Internal renal pyramid structures shown in macroscopic kidney profile.
Blood vessels terminate in anatomical common iliac bifurcations.

materials.look: Reddish-brown fibrous renal capsule with realistic subsurface scattering
Vascular granular pink-brown renal cortex and columns of Bertin
Striated deep purplish-crimson medullary pyramids collecting into renal papillae
Pale glistening cream minor/major calyces and funnel-shaped renal pelvis
Golden-ochre endocrine parenchymal adrenal gland cap
Oxygenated abdominal aorta, renal arteries, and iliac bifurcations
Deoxygenated inferior vena cava, renal veins (left crossing anterior to aorta), and iliac veins
Pale buff muscular peristaltic conducting ureter tubes
Vascular muscular detrusor urinary bladder and urethral outflow
